## HarborProxy VERSION

- Android: universal APK, signed with the fixed HarborProxy update identity.
- Windows: portable amd64 ZIP; unsigned.
- macOS: separate Intel and Apple Silicon DMGs; ad-hoc signed, not notarized.
- Linux: amd64 DEB.

Read `INSTALL-ZH-CN.txt` before installing.

HarborProxy is derived from GPLv3-licensed FlClash. Binary recipients must also
receive access to the corresponding source and the GPLv3 license.
